elements.text:
You and your friends took some pictures together. You look through your feed and see that they tagged you in a post. You don't like how you look in the picture.

Here are some feelings that might happen in the moment:

texts: I'm embarrassed by the face I'm making in the photo.
I feel happy it is a group photo.
I feel like everyone else looks better than me, but realize that is irrational thinking.
I'm proud of the outfit in the picture.
I'm annoyed that such a bad photo of me was posted, but remind myself that this isn't the end of the world.
